headline: Consumer prices rose more than expected in October
detail: This complicates the Fed's inflation fight and could delay rate cuts. For your tech and chip holdings, this means continued pressure as higher rates hurt growth stocks.
rec: No action based on this headline alone; monitor Fed commentary.
